product: Genie Code analysis for alerts is in Beta

what_it_does: If the Alertv2 Genie Analysis preview is enabled, alert owners can turn on Genie Code analysis in Advanced settings. When an alert changes to Triggered or Error, Genie Code starts an investigation and adds an Investigate link to the alert history. This page walks you through creating a Databricks SQL alert end to end.
